source: PixelLab create_map_object (style-matched against the house's own floor/grass/road pixels), downloaded 2026-10-17

cauldron.png.description: small black iron witch's cauldron on three short legs, bubbling green potion with a few glowing bubbles and wisps of steam

grave.png.description: fresh grave: a low oval mound of dark brown dirt with a small rounded grey stone tombstone standing at its head, a few tiny wildflowers

merchant_cart.png.description: abandoned wooden merchant cart tipped on its side with one broken wheel, torn canvas cover, spilled wooden crates, cloth sacks and a few glass potion bottles on the ground

stall_general.png.description: small wooden village market stall seen from above at an angle, sloped canvas awning with dark green and cream stripes on four posts, wooden counter in front with rows of small glass crystal vials, bundles of candlewick, coils of rope and a few wooden crates beside it

stall_bakery.png.description: small wooden village bakery market stall seen from above at an angle, sloped canvas awning with warm red and cream stripes on four posts, wooden counter in front piled with golden bread loaves, round honey pastries and baskets of rolls, a flour sack beside it

shopping_bag.png.description: a small dropped brown paper shopping bag tipped over on its side on the floor, a loaf of bread and two tiny glass vials spilling out

stone.png.description: a single smooth rounded grey river stone lying on the grass, palm sized, soft highlight

flower_patch.png.description: a small patch of wildflowers growing in the grass, white daisies and little blue flowers with green leaves

bouquet.png.description: a small hand-picked bouquet of white daisies and little blue wildflowers tied with a thin ribbon, lying flat on the grass

grave_pit.png.description: a freshly dug rectangular grave pit in the grass, dark brown loose earth with a small heap of dug soil beside it

wooden_sword_source.png.description: a small worn wooden practice sword for a child, plain wood blade and simple crossguard with a leather-wrapped grip, lying on the grass (came out with a steel blade)

wooden_sword.png.by: scripts/wooden-sword-recolour.py: the steel blade and brass guard recoloured tone for tone to wood; shape, outline and grip unchanged

old_tree.png.description: single huge ancient tree, very old wide gnarled trunk with hollow knot, twisting roots, broad canopy of deep red and orange ember-colored leaves, standing alone, top-down RPG map object
old_tree.png.use: the old tree over Alden's grave (MAIN_HOUSE), drawn at 2x; trunk base at source (80,135)

sword_planted.png.source: hand-drawn by scripts/planted-sword.py in the palette of wooden_sword.png
sword_planted.png.use: Sieg's wooden practice sword standing in the grave's soil, drawn at 2x

notes: Game copies are trimmed to their opaque bounds; pixels unchanged.
